placements.why: This envelope is a sample/e2e test asserting a reproduction of a known prod failure and a pass/fail bar for correctness — proof-of-behavior content, not a strategy, architecture, or product decision. No existing strata category was supplied to hold this, so the organizational tier itself needs a home for verification/testing artifacts before the leaf beneath it can attach anywhere.
placements.title: Proof as its own organizational category
placements.frame: What is this artifact demonstrating true — a test, a benchmark, a reproduction — rather than what is it building or deciding?

placements.title: Derive-id must survive malformed input, not just well-formed cases
placements.frame: When a heading arrives without an id field (the known prod failure shape), does the derive-id pass degrade safely — no crash, a valid slug — rather than merely succeeding on clean input?
placements.why: src-1 sets up a deliberate reproduction of a specific known production failure shape (## heading, no id field) and src-2 states the correctness bar that must hold once that shape is live (must not crash, must produce a valid slug). Together they name a durable theme future test envelopes will keep feeding — derive-id's robustness against malformed/missing-id input — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf was supplied to cover this subject, so it mints fresh under the newly-minted Proof stratum rather than as a standalone fact.
